description:
Get a free LiquidVision API key for this agent's owner, by email, without a browser.
    Works for a NEW email only (an existing account's key is never returned; its owner sees it
    at liquidvision.app/data). Use the key as X-API-Key on REST or on this MCP endpoint for
    300 req/min instead of the shared anonymous budget, and to upgrade later to Pro/Bot
    (history exports, webhook alerts). Ask the user for the email first; do not invent one.
name: get_api_key
